bio: An elegant baronial mansion, Grinkle Park is cradled between the North Yorkshire Moors and the stunning North East coast.  With all the atmosphere of a Victorian country house, and many of its original features including high embossed ceilings and fine wooden panelling, it's the place to relax in front of a roaring log fire.  The hotel is surrounded by 35 acres of fabulous grounds, including secluded woodland, a tranquil lake and views over the nearby Moors. The perfect venue for Afternoon Tea in the heart of this stunning part of England. Good food is a passion at the hotel and your Afternoon Tea will include a selection of finger sandwiches, cakes, scones with cream and jam as well as a variety of teas and coffees.
